name: The Dragon's Prize
source:
As the future ruler of Khorinea, you are the heir to a kingdom filled with magic and mystery, but one that is also in a state of decline. When a dragon attacks the castle during one fateful day, you're brought to its tower and kept prisoner. Although your "host" tries to be hospitable, you can't help but notice that it's hiding a very big secret...

[From [url=https://mei18.itch.io/the-dragons-prize]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
身为科里尼亚未来的统治者，你即将继承一个充满魔法与谜团、却已开始衰落的王国。决定你命运的那天，一条龙袭击了城堡，将你掳到自己的高塔囚禁起来。这位“主人”努力表现得殷勤好客，你却很难不注意到，它藏着一个天大的秘密…

〔摘自[url=https://mei18.itch.io/the-dragons-prize]itch.io[/url]〕
